query: INSERT INTO outbox_subscriber_failures(tenant,event_id,subscriber,available_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,now()+interval '2 seconds') ON CONFLICT(tenant,event_id,subscriber) DO UPDATE SET attempts=outbox_subscriber_failures.attempts+1,available_at=now()+least(300,power(2,least(outbox_subscriber_failures.attempts+1,8))::int)*interval '1 second',dead_letter_at=CASE WHEN outbox_subscriber_failures.attempts+1>=8 THEN now() ELSE NULL END
